component.name: Folio Draw
component.summary: Pictures, with layers and machine embroidery

description.p: Folio Draw is a quick, uncluttered picture editor: pencil, brushes, shapes, text, fill, selections, crop, resize and rotate, with layers, blend modes and real transparency. It opens and saves PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WebP, TIFF, Windows icons, Photoshop PSD and OpenRaster. Embroidery turns a picture into editable shapes and saves for the machine as PES, DST, JEF, EXP, VP3, XXX or PEC. Everything stays on this computer.
